newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Geneva airport Jan-April trucked airfreight jumps.
newsitem.headline: Geneva airport Jan-April trucked airfreight jumps.

text.p: Geneva's Cointrin airport handled 14,314 tonnes of trucked airfreight in the first four months of 1997, an increase of 39.8 percent on 1996 levels, airport authority figures show.

The growth in trucked airfreight, in the period in question, reflected Swissair offering less belly-capacity on long-haul passenger routes from Geneva and instead shipping more cargo between the airport and Zurich by road, an airport authority official told Reuters.
January-April 1997 flown airfreight handled at Geneva totalled 19,639 tonnes, down 9.3 percent on the same period last year, airport figures also showed.
Jan-Apr 1997 postal traffic handled at the airport fell by 4.8 percent on the same period in 1996 to 2,791 tonnes.

Swissair operates a three-times weekly full-freighter service between Geneva and Singapore, with stopovers at Dubai and Madras using a 67-tonne capacity McDonnell Douglas DC10-30F aircraft. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
